findings.detail: RE-QA after the writer-routed repair cycle: the built spec (db/recipes/chicken-marsala-skillet.json) and card (db/built/chicken-marsala-skillet.body.html) STILL do not exist. State file remains 'priced' (updated 2026-08-16 06:31:55, before the first QA fail) with no build/write entry in history. The repair that the first fail asked for - build the spec and card - was never performed, so every card-side check (spec ingredient coverage both directions, scaling in the spec, method, title, credit, prose numbers) remains unverifiable. This is the second fail on the same absent artifact.

Live page re-fetched cleanly on 2026-08-16 and matches the extraction exactly: title 'Easy Chicken Marsala', 4 servings, all 10 ingredient lines, all 5 steps, stated macros 428 cal / 26 P / 11 C / 26 F. The transcription is a faithful anchor; no extractor repair needed.

Mapped file applies one consistent 3.5x ratio (4 -> 14) on every line; the two derived quantities (chicken weight back-solved from the source's own 26 g protein/serving, dredging-flour allowance at 30 g per 4 cutlets scaled to 105 g) are documented derivations, not per-line drift. Whenever the spec IS built it should inherit these grams unchanged.

notes: Anchors: extraction AND live page (saltandlavender.com fetched cleanly both cycles); they agree completely, so everything that exists upstream is faithful to the source. The terminal fail is not a fidelity defect in the recipe - it is that the artifact under review was never produced, in either cycle. Marsala-wine commodity registrar ruling still pending (shared with chicken-chasseur), which is the likely reason the build never ran; that blocker belongs to the mapper/registrar lane, but the routed owner for the missing card remains the writer. Dispatch rule: second FAIL is terminal (rejected-qa).
